headline: Why a 15% Yield on Blue Chip Stocks Worries Even Income Investors
summary: A 15% monthly yield from an ETF built on Warren Buffett's favorite blue chips sounds almost too good to question, but the math behind that payout reveals a fragile engine that few income investors fully understand before buying in.
